title: Compartment door observed open after an unlock pulse
description: Published on locker/{locker_uuid}/event once the client has observed the physical door state following an open_compartment pulse (ADR-0040). The command response only acknowledges that the pulse was sent; this message reports whether the door actually opened. Current locker-client releases emit `outcome: opened` when the door is observed open within the detection window, with `detection_ms` measuring pulse to observation. `outcome: already_open` remains in the contract for backward compatibility and historical or backend-supported vocabulary; the current locker client does not emit new already_open events.

outcome.description: Current locker client emits opened only. already_open is retained for historical events and backend compatibility.

detection_ms.description: Milliseconds from the unlock pulse to the door being observed open. Omitted for historical already_open events.
